title: Six Words Written Down
subtitle: 建议与劝告 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 建议与劝告（做人与做事·建议与劝告）
meta: 主题语境：建议与劝告（做人与做事·建议与劝告）　|　核心词汇：advice　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 advice 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my grandmother gave my father ① a piece of advice, which was six words long, and he wrote it on the back of a bus ticket and did not do it for thirty-one years. She said advice is the only thing you can give that costs nothing and is never forgotten, and advice, she said, is what you say when you cannot bear to watch.

The ② advice itself was about a job in a town nine miles away, and he took the other job, and she never once said he had been wrong. He asked for her ③ advice on the house in 1971, which was the only time he ever did, and she said advice asked for is a different thing from advice given, and he said he had never known that.

The bank gave him ④ advice about the shop in 1984, which cost nine pounds and which he ignored, and my mother said paid advice is the only kind anybody ever listens to. Her own  advice about money was three words, written in a book she kept for forty years, and my father found it in 1996 and said it was the true thing anybody had ever told him.

In 1979 he gave me ⑤ some advice about school, which was the same six words, and I did not do it either, and he said nothing, and that was the first time I understood the word. My grandmother wrote in the book that ⑥ advice should always be followed by silence, and nobody in our family has ever managed that part; advice, she added, is the only gift that arrives twice.

The  advice I would give now, if anybody asked, is not the six words but the thirty-one years in which she did not repeat them. My father said in 1999 that ⑦ advice asked for should be written where the other person cannot find it for a very long time, and the ⑧ advice he never took is the only advice I have ever taken myself.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 建议；意见（泛指，不可数）
B. n. 劝告；忠告（含劝阻之意）
C. n. （专业人士／机构的）意见；咨询意见
D. n. 箴言；教诲（words of advice）
E. 固定搭配：a piece of advice 一条建议
F. 固定搭配：give / offer advice 提出建议
G. 固定搭配：ask for / seek advice 征求意见
H. 固定搭配：advice on / about ... 关于……的建议

items.q: a piece of advice, which was six words
The advice itself was about a job
her advice on the house in 1971
The bank gave him advice about the shop
advice should always be followed by silence
advice asked for should be written

answers.why: a piece of advice 意为“一条建议”，1968 年祖母给了父亲一条建议，只有六个词。
advice 意为“建议、意见”，那条建议是关于九英里外镇上一份工作的，而他选了另一份。
advice on ... 意为“关于……的建议”，1971 年他唯一一次就房子的事征求她的意见。
advice 意为“（机构的）咨询意见”，1984 年银行就店铺给了他一份意见，收了九英镑，他没听。
give advice 意为“提出建议”，1979 年父亲给了我一些关于学业的建议，还是那六个词。
advice 意为“箴言、教诲”，祖母在书里写道：箴言之后应当永远跟着沉默。
advice asked for 呼应“征求意见”，父亲说别人来征求的意见，应当写在对方很久找不到的地方。
advice 意为“忠告”，他从未听从的那条忠告，是我自己唯一听取过的忠告。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年祖母给了父亲一条建议，只有六个词，他把它写在了车票背面。（a piece of advice）
那条建议是关于九英里外镇上一份工作的，而他选了另一份。（advice）
1971 年他唯一一次就买房子的事征求了她的意见。（advice on）
1984 年银行就店铺给了他一份意见，收了九英镑，而他置之不理。（advice about）
1979 年父亲给了我一些关于学业的建议，还是那六个词。（give advice）
祖母在书里写道：建议之后应当永远跟着沉默。（advice）
answers: In 1968 my grandmother gave my father a piece of advice, six words long, and he wrote it on the back of a bus ticket.
The advice was about a job in a town nine miles away, and he took the other job.
In 1971 he asked for her advice on the house, which was the only time he ever did.
The bank gave him advice about the shop in 1984, which cost nine pounds and which he ignored.
In 1979 my father gave me some advice about school, and it was the same six words.
My grandmother wrote in the book that advice should always be followed by silence.
